agent_note: Third-person past narration centred on one character (Mariana), plus a first-person strand (q06426, q06449, q06450, q06454) that is itself mostly past-tense recollection - so the first-person strand does not make the book dual. Only q06426 is present-tense event narration, and it is a self-characterizing 'I'm the villain' rather than simultaneous action. Heavy aphorism load (13 gnomic of 57) is exactly the Goodreads quotability bias METHODOLOGY warns about; a two-bucket filter would have read those as present-tense evidence. Five borrowed epigraphs/verse quotations discarded as paratext. Two abstentions: q06434 (possible borrowed epigraph) and q06469 (unmarked present-tense first-person line that may be speech). No single quote could flip this book's label at 28 past / 1 present.
